summary: Tested Super Admin improvements for Kora OS ERP. All features working correctly: Backend APIs (7/7 passed), Frontend UI (all features verified). Organization names show instead of company IDs, create organization from Super Admin works, user org assignment works.

issues: Missing DialogDescription for ARIA accessibility - shows console warnings but doesn't affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Consider adding DialogDescription to dialog components for better accessibility (Warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent})
seed_data_creation: Created test organization during API testing (TEST_Org_* prefix)
